data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word beratos, meaning exalted berry. In Greek mythology, the goddess Aphrodite was said to have created the first berries from the blood of Adonis, making them a symbol of love, passion, and immortality. The name Beret carries the meaning “Exalted Berry” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beret usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted berry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
